changelog:
1. Custom Calling Profile & Usernames: Choose your own Name & Calling ID; others see your actual name when you call
2. Smooth Mobile Data Audio: Adaptive 32-frame playout jitter buffer & PLC eliminates voice breaking over 4G/5G
3. Vivo 24/7 Sleep Fix: Hardware RTC AlarmManager keeps Vivo Y51L connected even when screen is locked
4. 1-Click Updates: Seamless in-app updating with zero external browser downloads
5. Multi-Device Compatibility: Vivo Y51L, OnePlus, Samsung S24 Ultra & M35
